name: Hulegu Khan
contribution: A Mongol ruler who conquered much of West Asia.

checks.lead: Hulegu Khan, also known as Hülegü or Hulagu (c. 1217 – 8 February 1265), was a Mongol ruler who conquered much of West Asia. As a son of Tolui and the Keraite princess Sorghaghtani Beki, he was a grandson of Genghis Khan and brother of Ariq Böke, Möngke Khan, and Kublai Khan.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
